exposure: bilateral internal iliac artery ligation followed by hysterectomy
hysterectomy followed by bilateral internal iliac ligation
placenta left in situ followed by Injection Methotrexate
bilateral internal iliac ligation followed by myometrial resection
cohort: A cohort of 252 women aged 26-40 years with a mean gestational age of 35.6 weeks, undergoing cesarean section for morbidly adherent placenta.
finding: Surgical procedures incorporating bilateral internal iliac artery ligation for morbidly adherent placenta during cesarean section were associated with reduced intraoperative blood loss and improved outcomes compared to other surgical approaches.
mod_finding: The findings indicate that specific surgical approaches during cesarean section, particularly those involving bilateral internal iliac artery ligation, lead to improved maternal outcomes for morbidly adherent placenta.
